# Grafana LLMOps Forge

> A zero-dependency Python 3 toolkit and Claude Code Skill that turns any Grafana
> instance (OSS, Cloud, Enterprise) into an AI/LLM observability command center.
> It auto-discovers the LLM telemetry actually present and forges FinOps, gateway,
> agent/RAG, adoption, self-hosted-inference and EU AI Act governance dashboards —
> then vision-verifies the rendered result. Prerequisite: a Grafana URL and a
> service-account token. Nothing else to deploy; no data leaves your infrastructure.

Key facts:
- Prerequisite: one Grafana URL + a service-account token. Everything else is discovered or provisioned.
- Zero third-party dependencies: Python 3 standard library only, no `pip install`, fully auditable.
- Detects 4 telemetry dialects: OpenTelemetry GenAI (`gen_ai.*`), LiteLLM, self-hosted inference (vLLM/TGI/Ollama), and NVIDIA DCGM (GPU).
- Generates 6 dashboard blueprints: FinOps & cost, Gateway Operations, Agents & RAG, Adoption, Inference (self-hosted), EU AI Act Governance.
- Cost is computed from an embedded, date-stamped ~30-model pricing registry (input/output/cache; US/EU/Asia sovereignty) composed into PromQL.
- EU AI Act governance maps Articles 12, 26, 50 and 73 to measurable Grafana signals — this is observability *evidence*, not legal advice.
- Discovery-first: only panels backed by a real observed metric name are emitted (no "No data" panels).
- Vision-verified rendering: after deploy, the real dashboard render is screenshotted and inspected for correctness.
- Works offline: `python3 scripts/forge_dashboards.py --selftest` renders all six dashboards with no live Grafana.

## Topics
LLMOps observability, AI FinOps, Grafana LLM dashboard, EU AI Act monitoring,
gen_ai OpenTelemetry dashboard, self-hosted inference and GPU (DCGM) monitoring,
LiteLLM spend, vLLM metrics, token cost tracking, SLO alerting for LLM gateways.
